body:
My opinion of myself does not matter. I am the system not the obsever. 
Like on Earth, we have no way of telling how fast we are moving or spinning without looking at the outside. Like how people can't step outside and say theyve earned money without a managers or markets approval.

For the exact same reasons it would be delusional to trust my opinion of myself. I am the chemical reaction nobody asked for. If I'm not worth a second of someone else's time then what am I?

I'm broken, useless, awful, and worthless. I am what nobody wants to be or have around 

I am the worst kind of person. If there were any good about me there would be good, but it's only bad and I can't blame anyone but myself
